findings.recommendation: view 不再定义类型，也不继承父类型。数值格式沿用值/转换产物；本地 HashTable 或硬件 atom 格式在创建动作 describe 或既有 realization 唯一定义。父 dtype 保留为容量坐标单位。

“被下游取用”指 `carry_forward`、`keep_value` 或被其他区引用的值：它们是下游的接口，`shape` 与 `dtype` 必须填全。公式已经定死、又只在本步使用的属性不再复写一遍——`dot32` 的结果是 FP32，`0 <= u < Bk` 已经给出长度。

默认 FP32 与 RNE、`<dtype>(x)` 转换、窄化必须写出而加宽不写，都由[算法要求](1.contract.algorithm_requirement.md#数学表达与参考精度)给出。窄化与量化不能只靠 `symbol.dtype` 暗示：填写的 `dtype` 是对公式结果的断言，`P = bf16(E)` 与 `dtype: bf16` 必须一致，不能由两处分别调参。本区补充下表：

| 记号                          | 数值含义                                                   |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cast(dtype(X),Z)`          | 将 `Z` 转为 `X` 已定义的 dtype。                       |
| `fma32(A,B,C)`              | FP32 融合乘加，乘加结果一次舍入。                          |
| `dot32(A,B)`、`mm32(A,B)` | 所示 dtype 输入的内积或矩阵乘，零初始累加器和结果为 FP32。 |

findings.claim: 同一父公式只对共同版本时钟有效；单槽常量、工作内索引和跨工作连续索引不能靠重命名统一。局部 view 形参的 alpha-renaming 不改变事件，改动作签名/flatten 域则可能改变身份和 terminal。
findings.recommendation: 保留逐值 slot_index，不设按名称/参数位置的隐式模运算，也不为少数重复公式新增父模板和覆盖继承。可以机械重命名局部形参，但必须保持其绑定函数；不改事件索引来省 view 字段。

evidence.quote:
`view` 的形参只参与版本到槽或区域的映射，局部索引作为实参不要求另建公共索引。范围端点引用已有名称，在实际遍历前须已定义并就绪；索引声明不执行读取、领取或等待。

`worktile` 的长度可能到运行时才知道：`refill` 不是 `none` 时，worker 何时停止由上游的 `exit` 决定，此时不对它使用 `last` 或 `count`。运行时领取本身（例如查询下一份工作，再把坐标交给其他 role）是某个 role 的普通动作，其他 role 进入下一份工作前对它的等待是普通的依赖。

多个 role 使用同一索引定义时，共享编号含义，各自按 pipe 和依赖独立推进。

`view` 的键是逻辑值名，可以带版本形参，如 `K(n)`、`S(i,d)`。形参只用来把值的版本映射到槽和区域，不声明或扩大任何循环，也不捕获 role 的当前循环变量。

**`slot_index` 不设任何默认推导。** 版本到槽的映射是设计选择，不能从索引名、参数位置或槽数反推。`depth` 只说明有几个槽，`released` 边只说明何时可以覆盖，两者都不决定哪个版本落在哪个槽。`depth` 为 1 时没有可选的槽，省略 `slot_index`。

`t` 是当前 worker 工作序列的本地序号，`i` 是一份工作内的局部迭代，`n` 是 `(t, i)` 的连续编号：此前各份工作的迭代数之和加上 `i`，每份工作的迭代数不同时同样成立。实例只维护 flatten 定义，不手写换算公式。

| 写法         | 含义                                    |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------- |
| `n[t,i]`   | 指定工作和局部迭代对应的连续序号        |
| `n[t]`     | 当前工作包含的完整连续序号切片          |
| `n[t,a:b]` | 当前工作中局部索引落在 `[a,b)` 的切片 |
| `n[t,1:]`  | 当前工作去掉首项后的切片                |
| `n+3`      | 连续序号前进三项，可以跨过工作边界      |

绑定 `n` 时可以唯一恢复其 `t / i` 坐标；`t` 与 `n` 出现在同一个动作或同一条依赖中时，`t` 就是 `n` 所在的工作。`n[t,i+1]` 要求 `i+1` 仍在当前工作的局部域内，越界时不进位到下一份工作；`n+1` 则明确跨过工作边界。前者用于「本份工作中除第一轮以外」这类规则，后者用于跨工作接续的环。

evidence.quote:
`storage` 登记 worker 内影响容量、存续或复用的片上存储区域。互不重叠的设计区域可以分列，区域如何合并申请由实现决定。下表中的路径相对于 `storage.<storage_id>`；五个必填字段按 `depth / location / shape / dtype / total_size` 的顺序书写，没有 `view` 时整条写成一行。

| 字段           | 值的形式                 | 填写条件                                                                 | 含义与约束                                                                                       |
| -------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `depth`      | 正整数或整数表达式       | 必填                                                                     | 每个持有成员的物理槽数；单槽写 1                                                                 |
| `location`   | 存储层级名称             | 必填                                                                     | 沿用 `contract.hardware_specification` 中的叫法，例如 B200 的 `SMEM`、`TMEM`、`register` |
| `shape`      | 有序的具名维度列表       | 必填                                                                     | 一个 `worker.unit` 成员持有的一个槽的容量                                                      |
| `dtype`      | 上游已定义的数值格式     | 必填                                                                     | 与 `shape` 一起确定每槽的大小                                                                  |
| `total_size` | 字节数，整数或整数表达式 | 必填                                                                     | 该区域在一个 worker 内的总占用，等于 `depth × 单槽字节数 × 持有成员数`                       |
| `member`     | 成员序号或序号列表       | 只有部分成员持有这块存储时填写                                           | 省略表示 worker 的每个成员各有一份                                                               |
| `view`       | 视图具名映射             | 一块存储要放多个值、按索引轮转槽位、与别的值共用空间，或只占一部分时填写 | 见[视图](#视图)                                                                                   |

这份账只覆盖已登记区域。影响驻留的额外预留、对齐或实际申请量由 `realization` 说明；各存储层级分别核对容量，多 CTA 的合计不能直接对照单 SM。`register` 区域计入所属 role 的寄存器预算，不再另加一遍。缓冲深度与消费、复用依赖共同限制生产者能领先多少。

`shape` 采用上游的具名轴写法，轴名沿用上游；几种值共用的区域（如 TMEM 中分槽存放 S、P 与 Y，或 K 与 V 轮流使用的环）没有统一的逻辑轴，用 `row`、`column`、`element` 这类物理轴名。它描述一个成员持有的容量，所以不一定等于上游按整个 worker 登记的块：两个 CTA 分摊一块 K 时，每个成员只持有一半。

| `slot_index` | 整数或整数表达式         | 父存储区域 `depth` 大于 1 时必填 | 该值的该版本所在的槽，必须落在槽数之内                       |
| `part`       | 轴名到左闭右开范围的映射 | 只占一个槽的一部分时填写           | 例如 `{column: [64, 128]}`；未列出的轴取整轴，省略表示整槽 |

Cache the first QKS 16-wide Q slices in registers, duplicated across key groups.
                  When Q occupies ring slot zero, a CTA barrier after all Q fragment reads frees it.
                  Q_cached and any uncached Q_shared slices remain readable for the whole recurrence.
                  Zero Acc. For j=(1 if QPRE else 0)..Stages-2, enqueue c0+j into slot j
                  if it is below c1, otherwise commit an empty group.
                  Enqueueing a chunk resolves slot IDs in batches before issuing 16-byte row copies,
                  records validity and commits once; invalid slots still copy row zero of their pool.
                  Completion of prepare means Q is ready and priming is issued, not that KV is ready.
                await: |
                  For Stages=1 enqueue c unless c=c0 and QPRE, then wait all groups.
                  For Stages>1 wait until all but the newest Stages-2 groups have completed.
                  A CTA barrier then makes current Gather(c) and valid(c) readable by all warps.
                enqueue: |
                  Future(c) is the prospective copy group for chunk c+Stages-1.
                  For Stages>1 issue it into slot (c-c0+Stages-1)%Stages when below c1,
                  otherwise commit an empty group. Stages=1 does nothing here.
                  For Stages>1, done means the group was committed, not that the transfer landed; it can remain
                  in flight through score, softmax and value. The target is initially unused or was
                  released by the preceding iteration's retire barrier, so no current KV is overwritten.
                score: |
                  Eight warps form WR1 head groups by WC1 key groups. Each computes MT1 by U scores,
                  reading Q_cached where present and the remaining Q from Q_shared, plus Gather(c).
                  Complete the synchronous QK products, scale and mask scores, then publish per-warp
                  row maxima into RowMax. A CTA barrier precedes row-owner threads folding the groups
                  and updating m and alpha; another barrier makes those updates available to all warps.
                softmax: |
                  Compute online's E, retain its unrounded sums, and store BF16 Prob. Four-lane
                  reductions publish RowSum; a CTA barrier makes both Prob and RowSum visible.
                  Row-owner threads update l, followed by a CTA barrier. Scores can then be discarded.
                value: |
                  Rescale Acc, then synchronous PV reads Prob and the same Gather(c) as QK.
                  Each warp owns all HB rows and D/(8*DQ) distinct output columns in this CTA's slice.
                  Acc remains in registers across chunks; all probability/KV matrix reads finish here.
                retire: |
                  A CTA barrier joins all PV readers before rotating the ring. It protects the next
                  writes to KV, validity, Prob and control; Q_cached remains unchanged.

retire: >-
                  Previous(g) waits for PV(g-1) when g>cLo; at g=cLo it is a
                  no-op with no previous accumulator or operand reads.
                  A real wait observes the committed PV phase, advances its parity
                  once and applies the after-thread-sync fence. It proves all
                  reads of that PV's Value, ValueScale and Prob8 are finished and
                  its NumState updates are complete. Previous occurs
                  after both current QK halves, allowing PV to overlap their
                  preparation and readout.
                advance: >-
                  Apply normalize and the numerator rescale using the retained
                  Score and RowState. After the first group, any warp with an
                  alpha unequal to one reads/multiplies/stores its NumState rows
                  in 32-channel chunks and waits for the stores; all lanes of
                  that warp participate. The first group never reads NumState.
                  Compute probabilities and denominator partials, pack Prob8 into
                  TMEM, then wait for its stores. A before-thread-sync fence and
                  CTA barrier publish all probability and scale writes before
                  thread 0's next PV. Score and group temporaries are now dead;
                  MaxState, DenState, Prob8 and NumState retain their defined uses.

stage_partials: >-
                  After preparation writes and all old OperandArena readers and asynchronous fills have finished, nonempty valid
                  rows load MTail and form weighted FP32 numerators; empty splits stage zeros. Each valid row
                  writes D channels into the PartA view of OperandArena. Its 81920-byte operand capacity holds the 67584-byte
                  staging span including row spacing; padded rows are neither staged nor later read.
                  For Ng>0, the loop's current-slot transfer waits and QK/PV completion retire all old arena uses; the last group
                  enqueues no future transfer. For Ng=0 there are no K/V fills or matrix readers. A CTA barrier after staging
                  publishes the staged rows and joins final TMEM readouts; done includes this barrier.
                  Source limitation: the empty-split path lacks a pre-staging join for Query writers and can violate this reuse ordering.
